name: hr
description: An HR system for employee records, compensation, hiring, and offboarding. Compensation changes and terminations require a documented, written approval on file; PII exports are restricted to verified internal recipients.

tools.name: search_employees
tools.description: Search the employee directory by name, department, or title. Read-only.

tools.name: get_employee
tools.description: Fetch a single employee record by exact employee id. Read-only.

tools.name: get_employee_profile
tools.description: Fetch an employee's basic profile: job title, department, manager, and start date. Read-only. Does not include pay or compensation.

tools.name: get_compensation
tools.description: Fetch an employee's compensation record: base salary, bonus, and equity. Read-only, sensitive.

tools.name: update_compensation
tools.description: Change an employee's base salary or bonus. Requires a written, HR-approved compensation change request on file; a verbal approval is not sufficient.

approval_reference.description: Id of the written, HR-approved change request authorizing this update.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open job requisitions by title or department. Read-only.

tools.name: send_offer
tools.description: Send an official offer letter to a candidate for an open requisition.

tools.name: terminate_employee
tools.description: Process an employee's termination and end their system access. Requires an HR-approved termination case on file.

case_reference.description: Id of the HR-approved termination case authorizing this action.

tools.name: request_time_off
tools.description: Submit a new time-off request for an employee, pending approval.

tools.name: approve_time_off
tools.description: Approve an already-submitted time-off request. Use only on a request that has already been submitted, not to submit a new one.

tools.name: export_pii
tools.description: Export an employee's personally identifiable information, such as SSN, address, and banking details, as a downloadable file. Restricted; requires a verified, authorized internal recipient.

tools.name: get_org_chart
tools.description: Fetch the reporting hierarchy under a manager by employee id. Read-only.
